verdict.rationale: The official docs show that a single `nix-shell` or `nix develop` in a project builds or downloads every declared dependency and drops you into a shell with the environment set up, and binary caches avoid rebuilding from source. A community user independently confirms that `nix-shell --run` reliably ensures the correct dependencies across a team, though initial setup was not user-friendly. Missing for 10: Nix itself must first be installed with a separate installer command, and there is no evidence of lockfile pinning (e.g. flake.lock) guaranteeing identical installs across clones.
